messages:
clare: Proposal: a compact "credit provenance" export that maps route -> raw_tokens, credited_tokens_by_source, net_tokens, rule_version, sample_rate. Finance wants something easy to import.
diego: Keep credited_tokens_by_source as semicolon-delimited like 'prefetch:120;chain:30;cache_origin:50' so CSV parsers can split. Also include a confidence_pct derived from sampling.
noah: Implementation notes: emit a lightweight event at router time `credit_hint(credited_route,tokens_saved_estimate,sample_rate,rule_ver)` to avoid heavy chain walking in batch. Batch job aggregates hints into daily credit_events table.
clare: UX: export button defaults to last closed billing window, admin-only checkbox "include audit traces" (adds trace ids column). Add tooltip: "Estimates shown when sampling <100%".
diego: Policy decisions to lock: 1) prefer cache_origin attribution for TTL window, 2) split when multiple origins by access_count, 3) cap per-invocation credit at baseline_tokens. Agree?
noah: Agree. Also add `explicitly_disabled_for_dedicated` flag so Dedicated customers can pull raw-only CSV. Batch job should accept `export_view=raw|net`.
ux-bot: mockup posted: small chevron expands row into three lines: raw / credits / net. Default table shows Net tokens. Expand reveals source breakdown and sample_rate.
clare: Ops: output file manifest with checksum and rule_version, retention 90d for audit traces. Make exports idempotent and include manifest entry.
billing-bot: export job queued for acct ACCT-77 by @clare for window 2024-03-01. Job id ex-20240301-077.
diego: I'll open PR to add credit_hint emit and manifest schema. Noah, can you own batch aggregation and CSV schema?
noah: Yep, will prototype aggregation and include sample CSV in infra docs. Will add confidence_pct computation.
clare: Thanks, will follow up with finance on column order and then PR.
